criteria.text: A user can create, edit, assign, search and close tasks in their own tenant.
Search, lists and CSV export return only the requesting user's tenant's tasks.
A tenant admin can invite and remove users of their own tenant only.
The nightly summary job writes one summary per tenant counting only that tenant's tasks.
Support staff access follows the owner's decision and every support access is recorded in an audit log.
A request for another tenant's task, user or export by id gets the same not-found reply as a missing id and returns no data.
No cache entry, file name or background job result is shared between tenants.

owner_answers.answer: Support staff may read a tenant's data only, never change it, and every access is audited with the reason given.
When a tenant leaves, delete all its data within 30 days and keep only the audit log.
